findings.reason: Performance: `tab === 'compare' ? <ReleasesCompareTab/> : <ReleasesList/>` unmounts/remounts tab bodies; with QueryClient staleTime 0 (src/client/runtime/query-client.ts) every tab click refetches /api/releases, the full raw /diff/current delta (expensive server recompute), pushes, briefs and the banner's counter. The goal says a click only switches the tab. Fix: keep both bodies mounted and hide the inactive one, or have consumers under /releases read with refetchOnMount:false (the screen already observes these queries and release-diff-invalidation.ts keeps them fresh). Add a test asserting a tab switch issues no requests.

The 'removed deep link' test asserts ReleasesPage.length === 0 and regex-matches router.tsx source via readFileSync(process.cwd()) — cwd- and formatting-dependent; a behavioural assertion (render the route, ?tab=compare does not select Compare) is sturdier.
Unused code (promoted to blocking by the user rule): `export type ReleasesTab` has no reader outside this file; drop the export.
